'Peg-Perego Primo Viaggio 4-35 / Primo Viaggio 4-35 Nido' explicitly listed on Strolleria's BOB Alterrain / Alterrain Pro compatible-seat list.
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct seat-specific Toyota Tacoma data found. Carrier-only ~10 lb (base ~11 lb), carrier width ~17.25". The load-leg base needs floor contact, which is fine in a Tacoma rear footwell. Mid-large footprint; rear-facing in a Tacoma double-cab is tight front-to-back and will likely push the front seat forward; angle adjuster commonly recommended for RF in a Tacoma. No Tacoma 3-across data found for this seat.
